state.baseline: A draft may have many authors; one approver must have authored none of its revisions unless a valid waiver permits the conflict. The reviewer approves a specific complete immutable draft revision.
state.candidate: At draft creation choose one immutable reviewer R; every accepted draft or scope-decision revision records its author and rejects author R. No reviewer change is allowed within that draft. A freeze marker establishes an immutable revision; an authorized read side presents all accepted pre-marker facts. R personally reviews that version and approves its marker. The approval command checks R, the marker, and the boundary lifecycle; it does not scan or collect every scope decision. Exact revision, read completeness, stream ordering and freeze authority are assumed for these questions only.
state.late_change: A writer reads the draft as open; the draft freezes; the writer later appends a change without any atomic fence or ordered evaluation.
state.waiver: The baseline allows R to author a revision when an appropriate time-bound waiver is accepted at review. The candidate always rejects R as an author.

one_reviewer.instructions: Under candidate assumptions, is there exactly one named reviewer of the frozen whole draft?

multi_author.instructions: Under candidate assumptions, may two different people other than R both author revisions of the same draft?

author_rule.instructions: If every accepted revision rejects R as author, has R authored any accepted revision of that draft?

same_workflows.instructions: Can a person author a revision and later become the draft reviewer under the candidate as described?

waiver_equivalent.instructions: Does candidate preserve the authoring permitted in waiver without adding a restriction?

no_write_scan.instructions: Must the candidate approval command itself scan every scope decision, given the candidate assumptions?

marker_truth.instructions: Does a marker by itself prove that a lagging projection displays every accepted pre-marker revision?

late_append.instructions: Can the writer in late_change append after the draft freezes?

review_not_report.instructions: Does a complete projection by itself prove that R personally reviewed the frozen version?

human_evidence.instructions: If R explicitly attests review of the exact immutable version, is the attestation R’s recorded statement rather than a computation over every item?

source_assumed.instructions: Do the assumptions in candidate prove that the deployed provider actually supplies atomic ordered freezing?
